title: Page 10
content_zh:
旁边跟着的小星跟小月，有点困惑的互看一眼，小星小声问：「少爷不是也要跟姑娘一起搬到山中别院吗？」
「是啊，少爷说要娶一送一，他要看着姑娘，不让姑娘被汤爷欺负。」小月也小声说。
但再小声，两人就在夏羽柔姊弟身边，姊弟俩还是听见了，突然就一起笑了。
汤绍玄微笑的看着夏羽晨将夏羽柔背进喜轿里。
夏羽柔坐在喜轿里，随着队伍摇摇晃晃的前行，她知道汤绍玄就在她前面，她也知道，从今而后，她将与他一起迎接人生风雨，祸福与共。
执子之手，与子偕老。
怀着对未来的美好期许，迎亲队伍来到装饰得喜气洋洋的山中别院，何忠亲自招待所有的宾客，司马博彦、司马湘芸及苏姑娘那群姑娘和家人，吴奕、曾大虎等采石场的管事工人，叶嬷嬷、沈铭、大腹便便的沈阿莲、阿春等都参加这场婚宴，就连范梓璃也在何忠秘密安排下，在一个房间观看这场婚礼。
在众人的见证下，汤绍玄与夏羽柔拜堂成亲，送入新房。
汤绍玄在外面招待宾客不久，很快就回到新房，但喝多的吴奕等人叫着要闹洞房，最后还是被何忠派人拉走的。
汤绍玄一进来，扫了小星、小月一眼，两人急急退出去。
看着坐在床上的新娘，他走过去，拿起喜秤掀起红盖头，露出夏羽柔张绝丽脱俗的容颜，她微微抬头，甜美而羞涩。
汤绍玄拿起交杯酒，两人共饮。
「你好美。」
听着他的赞美，接触到他如同燃起两簇火焰的眼神，她的心怦怦狂跳，又羞涩又紧张，感觉手上的杯子被拿走，头上的凤冠被摘下，发丝洒落。
他的唇缓缓落在她的唇瓣，慢慢的、好好的疼爱她。
占有的那一刻来临时，他温柔的吻住她的低泣……
第二日，温暖的冬阳洒进新房。
红罗帐内，鸳鸯喜被里露出一截光滑如玉的玉手，正好遮住胸前风光，夏羽柔有些迷糊的张开眼睛，就看到近在咫尺的汤绍玄，想起夜里的颠鸾倒凤，粉脸涨红。
汤绍玄支起手肘，侧看着娇羞无比的妻子，以低沉而沙哑的声音道：「早安。」
「早。」

汤绍玄伸手环住她纤细的腰肢，轻轻的在她额际留下一个吻。
他脸上那股满足幸福的笑容，让她看了一笑，却也忍不住的又打个呵欠。
他昨晚稍微没有节制，见状心疼的说：「再睡会儿。」
「嗯。」
嫁给他很美好，晨昏定省、立规矩什么问题都省了，夏羽柔迷迷糊糊的又睡过去。
再醒起来时，他已一身绸缎袍服，清俊迷人。
小星小月进来伺候她梳洗，两人一起用早膳，汤绍玄突然拿出一个首饰盒。
她有些不解的型典雅，一看就知是昂贵的东西——
「这套首饰不能在外面戴，至少，在外人看来，我财力还不能买这一套首饰给你前，你只能戴给我看。」
「这是……」
「京城里的人都知，镇国公府的世子爷，文韬武略精通，才貌双全，智勇兼备，但只有亲近的家人及贴身侍卫知道，他从小就醉心于玉雕，还寻求名师教授，练得一手好雕工，镂空雕技相当厉害，雕山水人物都引人入胜。」
见她惊讶的瞪大眼，他笑了。
「他曾亲手雕刻一座七层玲珑玉塔，该物不见瑕疵，塔身雪白，见者无不赞叹连连，只是他赠送给祖母作为寿礼时，说是他辗转从一名低调珍藏美玉公子山子雕作品的姓闲聊的话题，而天子更是眼馋，前往镇国公府赏玩几回，堂堂天子不好拉下面子讨要，虽然镇国公老夫人愿意割爱，但传出去总是难听，天子还是婉拒了。」
「天啊，不要告诉我，我想的正是你要说的。」她想尖叫了。
「世人不知美玉公子就是镇国公府的世子爷，也就是你的夫君。」
她可以昏倒吗？
不，这么好的事，她应该尖叫，她都不知道他这么有才！
「夫君，我这算不算是捡到宝？你人帅、文武兼备、还有一手好雕工——妥当了，我这是抓到一棵摇钱树啊。」
汤绍玄看她一副财迷样，也笑开了。
他再从袖里拿出一只玉雕小狗，夏羽柔几乎是一眼就爱上了，「好可爱，而且，它的眼睛好像我！」

「我是依你的眼睛雕的，就在那一天之后……」
汤绍玄在她耳畔轻轻诉说她酒醉那一日的举措，一边把她带回床上，他的唇沿着她的唇慢慢移往颈边，一路往下——
新婚夫妻，一晌贪欢。
事后，汤绍玄命人备热水，小星、小月脸红红的伺候夏羽柔沐浴。
热气氤氲，她舒服的靠在浴桶边缘，感觉温柔的水抚摸着身体各处，昏昏欲睡，就连小星、小月离开，她也不知道，直到一双有力的臂膀将她抱起。
「玄……」
她粉脸羞红，像只红虾子被他抱在怀里，回到床上。
他用软布替她一点点的擦拭头发，前方的铜镜中映出此时的画面，男人坐在女子后方，表情温柔，女子雪肤乌发，头半低垂，娇羞可见，那坦露的身体更是美丽。
男子擦拭后，手就不太安分，她可没敢再看向铜镜，低低呻吟出声。
除夕夜，阖家团圆，雪花飘飘，翌日一早，院里外都是一片厚实的白雪，鞭炮声响再起，夹杂着孩童快乐的嘻闹笑声，一家家张灯结彩贺新年，喜气洋洋。
汤绍玄坐在书案前，看着坐在另一边为他缝衣服的夏羽柔，想着刚刚得到的消息。
京城那边快变天了。
皇帝入冬后，身体就不好，如今更显虚弱。
容妃及贾相那一派野心勃勃，急着想劝皇上废太子立新储，但几位朝臣联名请奏国事改由太子操劳，让皇帝好好养身体。
皇帝无法明确下达旨意，太子就势监国，趁机扫清障碍。
容妃与其他皇子们个个心急如焚，他们其中有人筹谋多年，好不容拉下镇国公府，令皇后与太子被软禁，如今皇帝缠绵病榻，仍由太子主政，叫他们怎么甘心？
但太子羽翼丰满，登帝位再适合不过，朝中重臣都拥护太子登基，直到那时，容妃及贾相一派等人才发现太子早已暗地壮大，他们太轻忽了。
一个月后，太子承继大统。
新皇登基，即重审当年镇国公府谋逆一案，有新事证及人证，镇国公府平反，贾氏一族诬陷罪坐实，且暴露的罪行愈来愈多，各地入狱的贾氏族人更多，罪名多是敛财、搜括民脂民膏。
再一个月后，新皇派人到青雪镇，打算要给汤绍玄恢复身分，继承镇国公的爵位。

但汤绍玄拒绝了，他不想当年换囚的事再被牵扯出来，原来的范靖渊已死，他对汤绍玄这个身分很满意。
同年，范梓璃离开官家绣坊，风风光光回到京城，做回镇国公府的嫡大小姐。
夏羽晨在多年后，三元及第，成为大魏朝上史上第一位最年轻的状元郎，那时的汤绍玄和夏羽柔已经是两个孩子的爹娘。
夏羽柔有个状元弟弟，两个可爱孩子，一个隐藏版的镇国公夫君，还有他身后的皇帝、太后，嫁给靖王的王妃小姑——她表示自己幸福又美满，她谢天、谢地、谢谢在她生命中出现的每一个人。
content_en:
Xiaoxing and Xiaoyue, who were following next to them, looked at each other a little confused. Xiaoxing asked in a low voice: "Isn't the young master also going to move to the mountain villa with the girl?"
"Yes, the young master said that he would marry one and get one free. He wanted to watch over the girl and prevent her from being bullied by Mr. Tang." Xiao Yue also whispered.
But no matter how quiet it was, the two of them were right next to Xia Yurou's sister and brother. They still heard it and suddenly laughed together.
Tang Shaoxuan watched with a smile as Xia Yuchen carried Xia Yurou into the wedding sedan.
Xia Yurou was sitting in the wedding sedan. As the procession swayed forward, she knew that Tang Shaoxuan was in front of her. She also knew that from now on, she would face the ups and downs of life with him, sharing weal and woe.
Hold your hand and grow old together.
With good expectations for the future, the wedding team arrived at the joyfully decorated mountain courtyard. He Zhong personally entertained all the guests, including Sima Boyan, Sima Xiangyun and Miss Su's group of girls and their families, Wu Yi, Zeng Dahu and other quarry management workers, Grandma Ye, Shen Ming, the pot-bellied Shen Alian, Achun, etc. all attended the wedding banquet. Even Fan Zili watched the wedding in a room under He Zhong's secret arrangement.
Under the witness of everyone, Tang Shaoxuan and Xia Yurou went to the church to get married and moved into their new house.
Tang Shaoxuan entertained guests outside for a short time, and soon returned to the new house. However, Wu Yi and others who drank too much shouted that they wanted to have a wedding, and were finally pulled away by He Zhong.
As soon as Tang Shaoxuan came in, he glanced at Xiaoxing and Xiaoyue, and they hurriedly exited.
Looking at the bride sitting on the bed, he walked over, picked up the wedding scale and lifted the red hijab, revealing Xia Yurou's beautiful and refined face. She raised her head slightly, sweet and shy.
Tang Shaoxuan picked up a glass of wine and the two drank together.
"You are so beautiful."
Listening to his praise and seeing his eyes that were like two clusters of flames, her heart was beating wildly. She was shy and nervous. She felt that the cup in her hand was taken away, the phoenix crown on her head was taken off, and her hair fell down.
His lips slowly fell on her lips, loving her slowly and well.
When the moment of possession came, he kissed her softly and cried...
The next day, the warm winter sun shines into the new house.
Inside the red tent, a smooth jade-like hand was exposed under the quilt, which just covered the scenery on her chest. Xia Yurou opened her eyes in confusion and saw Tang Shaoxuan close at hand. Thinking of the topsy-turvy phoenix at night, her pink face turned red.
Tang Shaoxuan propped up his elbows, looked sideways at his extremely shy wife, and said in a low and hoarse voice, "Good morning."
"Morning."
Tang Shaoxuan put his arms around her slender waist and gently kissed her forehead.
The satisfied and happy smile on his face made her smile, but she couldn't help but yawn again.
He was a little out of control last night, and when he saw this, he said distressedly: "Let's sleep a little longer."
"Yeah."
It was wonderful to be married to him. It eliminated all the problems of settling down at dawn and dusk and setting rules. Xia Yurou fell asleep again in a daze.
When he woke up again, he was already dressed in silk robes, handsome and charming.
Xiaoxing Xiaoyue came in to help her wash up, and they had breakfast together. Tang Shaoxuan suddenly took out a jewelry box.
She was a little puzzled by the elegance of the style, and she could tell it was expensive at a glance——
"This set of jewelry cannot be worn outside. At least, in the eyes of outsiders, you can only wear it for me until I have the financial resources to buy this set of jewelry for you."
"This is..."
"Everyone in the capital knows that the eldest son of the Duke of Zhenguo is proficient in literature, martial arts, talent, appearance, wisdom and bravery, but only close family members and personal guards know that he has been obsessed with jade carving since he was a child. He also sought out famous teachers to teach him, and he became a good carver. His hollow carving skills are very good, and he can carve fascinating landscapes and figures."
Seeing her eyes widen in surprise, he smiled.
"He once carved a seven-story exquisite jade pagoda with his own hands. There was no flaw in the object and the pagoda body was snow-white. Everyone who saw it praised him repeatedly. However, when he gave it to his grandmother as a birthday gift, he said that he had passed on it from a lowly person.The emperor was even more coveted and went to the Zhenguo Duke's Mansion to view it several times. The majestic emperor was embarrassed to ask for it. Although the old lady of the Zhenguo Duke was willing to part with her, it would always be unpleasant to hear the news, so the emperor declined. "
"Oh my god, don't tell me, I was thinking exactly what you were going to say." She wanted to scream.
"The world doesn't know that Mr. Meiyu is the eldest son of Zhenguo Palace, and is also your husband."
Can she pass out?
No, such a good thing, she should scream, she didn't even know he was so talented!
"Husband, do I find a treasure? You are handsome, good at both civil and military skills, and you are a good carver - that's it, I have found a money tree."
Tang Shaoxuan also laughed when he saw that she looked like she was obsessed with money.
He took out a jade-carved puppy from his sleeve, and Xia Yurou fell in love with it almost at first sight, "It's so cute, and its eyes look like mine!"
"I carved it according to your eyes, just after that day..."
Tang Shaoxuan whispered in her ear what she did that day when she was drunk. While taking her back to bed, his lips slowly moved along her lips to her neck, all the way down——
The newlyweds had a moment of fun.
Afterwards, Tang Shaoxuan ordered people to prepare hot water. Xiaoxing and Xiaoyue waited for Xia Yurou to take a bath with blushing faces.
The heat was thick, and she leaned comfortably against the edge of the tub, feeling the gentle water caressing all parts of her body. She fell asleep. Even Xiaoxing and Xiaoyue left, but she didn't know until a pair of strong arms picked her up.
"Xuan..."
She blushed like a red shrimp in his arms and returned to bed.
He wiped her hair bit by bit with a soft cloth, and the scene at this time was reflected in the bronze mirror in front of him. The man was sitting behind the woman, with a gentle expression. The woman had snow-skinned black hair, her head was half lowered, and her shyness was visible. Her exposed body was even more beautiful.
After the man wiped it, his hands became restless. She did not dare to look at the bronze mirror again and moaned softly.
On New Year's Eve, families were reunited and snowflakes were falling. Early the next morning, there was thick white snow inside and outside the courtyard. The sound of firecrackers was heard again, mixed with the happy laughter of children. Every family decorated the lights to celebrate the New Year, and they were full of joy.
Tang Shaoxuan sat in front of the desk, looking at Xia Yurou who was sitting on the other side sewing clothes for him, thinking about the news he had just received.
Things are about to change in the capital.
The emperor's health has not been good since winter, and he is even more frail now.
The faction of Concubine Rong and Prime Minister Jia were ambitious and eager to persuade the emperor to depose the prince and establish a new heir. However, several courtiers jointly requested that the prince should take care of the state affairs and let the emperor take good care of his health.
The emperor was unable to issue a clear decree, so the prince took charge of the country and took the opportunity to remove obstacles.
Concubine Rong and the other princes were all very anxious. Some of them had been planning for many years to finally bring down the government and put the queen and the prince under house arrest. How could they be willing to accept that the emperor was still on his sick bed and the prince was still in charge?
However, the prince had full wings and was perfect for ascending to the throne. The important ministers in the court all supported the prince's ascension to the throne. It was not until then that Concubine Rong, Jia Xiangyi and others discovered that the prince had secretly grown. They were too negligent.
A month later, the prince succeeded to the throne.
When the new emperor ascended the throne, the case of the Zhenguo government's rebellion was re-examined. With new evidence and witnesses, the Zhenguo government vindicated the case. The false accusations of the Jia family were found to be true, and more and more crimes were exposed. More Jia family members were imprisoned in various places. The charges were mostly for amassing money and collecting people's wealth.
A month later, the new emperor sent people to Qingxue Town, intending to restore Tang Shaoxuan's status and inherit the title of Duke of the town.
But Tang Shaoxuan refused. He didn't want to be involved in the prisoner exchange again. The original Fan Jingyuan was dead, and he was very satisfied with Tang Shaoxuan's identity.
In the same year, Fan Zili left the official embroidery workshop and returned to the capital in glory, becoming the eldest daughter of the Duke of Zhen.
Many years later, Xia Yuchen passed the Three Yuan Dynasty and became the first and youngest number one scholar in the history of the Wei Dynasty. At that timeTang Shaoxuan and Xia Yurou are already the parents of two children.
Xia Yurou has a younger brother who is number one, two lovely children, a hidden version of the Duke of Zhenguo, as well as the emperor, the queen mother, and the princess sister-in-law who married Prince Jing behind him. She said that she is happy and happy, and she is grateful to God, to earth, and to everyone who appears in her life.
